adopted_rules: one dominant diagonal close-up carries the image
copy on the quiet side, never over texture
excluded_elements: copy placed over the ribbed mat

adopted_rules: deep grey ground, accent-coloured short titles, white body
working end shown large, small secondary
restrained neutral ground; headline -> detail -> caption order

tokens.palette_note: bg/accent come from the job palette (brandkit_set.py); the ground is a lit radial built from --bg (key light 22%/14% mixed 32% toward #6A7380, darker floor) plus 5% feTurbulence grain; job.ground='carbon' adds the 20px diagonal pattern. The accent is one token (--accent); --hi (74% accent) colours the headline keyword, --hi-meta (58% accent) the eyebrow. No coloured rim glow by default.
tokens.type_floor_note: size steps never drop under the QA mobile floor (headline 14px, title 12px, body 10px at 360 wide): body = ceil(10.05*W/360) = 42 at 1500, 34 at 1200

type_scale.eyebrow: Inter 700 28px, tracking .16em, uppercase, --hi-meta (zh: Noto Sans SC 700 30px)
type_scale.headline: Archivo 850 stretch 112% 104px, line-height .96, word-spacing .1em, uppercase, keyword in --hi; steps 104/96/88/80/72/64/58 (zh 100/92/84/76/68/60), never under 14px at 360
type_scale.f_title: Archivo 800 stretch 106% 60px uppercase (≈58% of the headline); steps 60/56/52/48 (zh 58/52/48/44), 2 lines preferred, 3 max
type_scale.f_body: Inter 500 42px (1500) / 34px (1200), 80% cream, 2 lines (3 only as a noted last resort)
type_scale.bar: 6x120 accent bar between title and body
type_scale.chip: TPL.chip dark, h 124, value 60px, label 24px (meta caption)

geometry.rail_panel_share: 0.36 two close-ups / 0.32 one (portrait 0.38 / 0.34), widens in 0.02 steps to 0.50 for copy
geometry.circle_inset_r: min(0.14W, 210) at 1500, 48px inside the macro's left edge, bottom at floor-72
geometry.macro_feather: 40px on the bottom bleed only (band: top and bottom)

elements.crop_policy: explicit_bleed (right/bottom; also top when there is no header)

adaptation_rules: header (eyebrow + headline) always runs the full measure on the ground; nothing is drawn over the picture

layout: 'rail' with two close-ups (copy panel left, macro bleeds right/bottom with a hard shadow-casting edge), 'band' with one (feature stack under the header, macro full width below with 40px top/bottom feather); 'stack' is read as 'band'

rail panel widens 2% at a time (to 0.50W) until every title fits 3 lines (2 preferred), every body 2 lines and f1 ends 72px above f2; then bodies may take 3 lines with a note; copy never crosses the panel edge
headline: largest step that fits 2 lines (en), 3 as fallback; zh keeps written lines, and in band joins two phrases with an ideographic space when they fit one line
eyebrow keeps its slot: when the headline contains it, the echo is removed from the headline ('Up close' + 'THE DETAILS'); the eyebrow is dropped only if nothing would remain
en hyphenated compounds never break at the hyphen (nowrap span)
zh titles and bodies that wrap break after the clause mark (，、；：); if a clause still wraps inside itself the panel widens, and over budget the plain wrap is kept
circle inset sits fully inside the macro (48px from its edge); its caption is on the panel beside it, the caption's accent bar runs on as a leader (TPL.elbowLeader) to the ring
cone from the inset to features[1].source only when given and visible

macro crop: cover, zoom job.macro_zoom (default 1.0, pulled back so the object reads whole), upscale cap 1.25 by shrinking the frame, edge snap 0.09, named parts (features[].parts) never sliced, optional overscan
rim light off by default (job.rim true or opacity: neutral warm white #FFF1DC, 12px blur)
specs chips (job.specs) under f1 when there is room, skipped with a note otherwise
notes: stock copy, body that repeats its title, panel widened, copy over budget

render_outputs.path: scratchpad t02/final_*.png and t02/v10 (tote fixture, en 10 + zh 12 versions, 4:5 en 0/3/5/9 zh 0/5/10)

limitations: all copy is neutral visual description, not approved product claims
element boxes are the measured layout of one render; real layout is computed per job
material realism (leather grain, stitching, canvas weave) and sharpness depend on the render assets; the template cannot add them
the template cannot see asset._parts (stripped by the renderer): without features[].parts a crop can still slice a part when the focus puts it near a frame edge
the inset-to-hero cone needs features[1].source; the leader only ties the inset to its caption
band crops are wide (≈1.6:1 at 1500): a far-off focus can show mostly ground
the rail panel keeps some open ground between the two features when the copy is short and no specs are sent

optional_job_fields.d1_width: macro share of the width in rail (panel = 1 - d1_width as the starting share)
optional_job_fields.panel_max: widest panel share the copy may claim (0.5)
optional_job_fields.d2_width: circle inset diameter share (0.28, r capped at 210 at 1500)
optional_job_fields.overscan: share of the picture kept outside bleed frames (0)
optional_job_fields.edge_snap: crop snaps flush to the picture edge within this share (0.09)
optional_job_fields.features[].parts: [{name, box:[x0,y0,x1,y1]}] 0-1 picture units; crops slide so no part is sliced
optional_job_fields.features[1].source: [nx, ny] in the macro picture: draws the translucent cone to the inset
optional_job_fields.specs: [{icon, value, unit, label}] up to 3 dark spec chips under feature 1
optional_job_fields.rim: true or opacity (≤0.5) turns on the neutral rim light
optional_job_fields.band_min_macro: share of H under which a band macro is noted as short (0.5)

elements_note: measured on the en fixture version 0 (1500x1500, rail); band layout (one close-up): header, then f1 full measure, then the macro full width from ~0.37H to the floor
